answered_by.gloss_en: אם קרית לא שנית, אם שנית לא שלשת, אם שלשת לא פירשו לך -- 'the living know that they will die' are the righteous, called living even in death (18a.14), and 'the dead know nothing' are the wicked, called dead even in life (18b.3); the verse does not speak of the righteous dead (= p_hachayim_hem_tzaddikim, p_hametim_hem_reshaim)
